main_text.p:
des, majorem alterum, alterum minorem, si interjecto baculo conjuncti, è fenestra domus simul solverint, præcurrere majorem, & primò subjectam aream contingere, sequi minorem; si verò soluti fuerint, comitari inter se, & eodem ambos momento ad terram allidi? Notasti item lapides, majorem alterum, alterum minorem, si quod ad terram è turris apice stadium est, decurrant, mediam propè curriculi partem æquis passibus metari, inde subitò majorem antevertere, & longo minorem intervallo, post se relinquere? * Hoc effectum dabit: sume tibi stateram A., & in una ejus lance pone lapidem B.; in altera lance plumbum C., eâ quantitate, ut fiat equilibrium inter B. & C. Stateram A. sic instructam, demerge sub aquam: fac liberè pendeant* Notasti lapidem
in aqua, ita ut nulla pars ejus fundum aut latera tangat. Videbis lapidem A. attolli in aqua; plumbum B. deprimi.

page.notes: The left-margin note is printed in italic and is set beside the text; the footnote below the text is in italic. The right edge carries show-through from the facing page, not transcribed. Some words in the margin and the footnote are difficult to read at this scan resolution.
